test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Heptathlete Swapna Barman hails from the state of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Swapna Barman became the** first Indian female heptathlete to win gold in the Asiad event.**
 
• She overcame an immense amount of pain to script the record in **Jakarta.**
 
• She finished with her** personal best score of 6026 which included her personal best throw in Javelin.**
 
• She **hails from the Jalpaiguri district of West Bengal.**
 
• In August 2019, she was honoured with the** Arjuna Award.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Heptathlon:**

 
 
• It is a seven-event contest that covers a range of track and field events and is spread over two days.
 
• The first day comprises **100m hurdles, a high jump, a shot put, and 200m, while day two has a long jump, javelin, and 800m.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Games:**

 
 
• It is the oldest and most prestigious event on the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) calendar, dating back to the inaugural edition in 1951.
 
• Like the Olympic games, they are held every four years.
 
• The 2018 Asian Games in Jakarta and Palembang, Indonesia will be the 18th edition.
